item.title: Kukie GitOps.03 Merge Approval
item.description: From an approval click to a merged pull request — rechecking file blobs and base before merging, the missing server route that left a card spinning, recording the merge first, separating the response from sync watching after a CloudFront 504, and replacing a stale AI answer with a code-written sentence.
